name: SSHI_LC_Filter
rationale: The current best designs fail only on S3 ripple (54-56mV vs 50mV limit). S3 has a very light load (2.2 MOhm), meaning the ripple is dominated by the charge injection pulses from the SSHI inversion. Adding a small series inductor between the rectifier and the storage capacitor creates a low-pass LC filter, which will smooth the current spikes and reduce the voltage ripple on 'out' without significantly impacting startup time or efficiency.
